sloka: अकार्यं ये न जानन्ति नैरृताः पापकारिणः ।अधर्मात्तु महोत्पातो भविष्यति हि साम्प्रतम् ।। ५.२४.३३।।।।
transliteration: akāryaṁ ye na jānanti nairṛtāḥ pāpakāriṇaḥ ।adharmāttu mahotpāto bhaviṣyati hi sāmpratam ।। 5.24.33।।।।

translations.english: 'Mythili, act according to our advice. I am your wellwisher. Give up sorrow and stop shedding useless tears.
